extracted_topics_and_scope.title: Etymology and Names of India
extracted_topics_and_scope.focus: English proper noun 'India', Classical Latin India, Hellenistic Greek India, Ancient Greek Indos, Achaemenian Old Persian Hindu, Sanskrit Sindhu, Indoi, Bharat, Bharatavarsha, Hindustan, Middle Persian origin, Mughal Empire usage

extracted_topics_and_scope.title: Ancient India: Early Humans and the Indus Valley Civilisation
extracted_topics_and_scope.focus: Homo sapiens arrival from Africa (80,000-50,000 years ago), genetic diversity, Neolithic period at Mehrgarh, domestication of barley and zebu cattle, Indus Valley Civilisation (2500-1900 BCE), Mohenjo-daro, Harappa, Dholavira, Ganweriwala, Rakhigarhi, standardised weights, steatite seals, written script, urban planning, public works, pottery, terracotta figures

extracted_topics_and_scope.title: The Vedic Period and Early Sanskrit
extracted_topics_and_scope.focus: Archaic Sanskrit diffusion (1500-1200 BCE), Rig Veda, Indo-Aryan migration, settlement of Ganges river plain, deforestation, iron implements, Dravidian language supplantation, Classical Sanskrit, Panini's Astadhyayi, Epic Sanskrit, Mahabharata, Ramayana

extracted_topics_and_scope.title: Rise of New Religions and the Maurya Empire
extracted_topics_and_scope.focus: Second urbanisation on Ganges plain, varna (caste) system, Jainism (Mahavira), Buddhism (the Buddha), non-violence, Maurya Empire, Ashoka (268-232 BCE), Kalinga conquest, policy of dhamma, rock and pillar edicts, environmental ethos

extracted_topics_and_scope.title: The Gupta Empire and South Indian Kingdoms
extracted_topics_and_scope.focus: Gupta Empire administration and taxation, renewed Hinduism (devotion), flowering of art, literature, and science, Sangam literature, Cheras, Cholas, Pandyas, Kaveri and Vaigai river valleys, Pallavas, Bhakti movement, trade with Roman Empire and Southeast Asia

extracted_topics_and_scope.title: Medieval India: Regional Kingdoms and Islamic Influence
extracted_topics_and_scope.focus: Early medieval age (600-1200 CE), regional kingdoms, caste society evolution, Tamil devotional hymns, temple towns, export of culture to Southeast Asia (Myanmar, Thailand, Laos, Brunei, Cambodia, Vietnam, Philippines, Malaysia, Indonesia), Muslim Central Asian nomadic clans, Delhi Sultanate (1206), Indo-Islamic culture, Vijayanagara Empire, Shaivite tradition

extracted_topics_and_scope.title: The Mughal Empire
extracted_topics_and_scope.focus: Mughal Empire establishment, administrative practices, Akbar, Persianised culture, economic policies, silver currency, patronage of painting, textiles, and architecture, Marathas, Rajputs, Sikhs, decentralisation of imperial authority

extracted_topics_and_scope.title: Colonial India: The East India Company and British Crown Rule
extracted_topics_and_scope.focus: English East India Company, coastal outposts, control of Bengal (1765), transition to colonial economy (raw materials), Lord Dalhousie, railways, canals, telegraph, Indian Rebellion of 1857, British Crown rule (1858), Indian National Congress (1885), commercialisation of agriculture, famines

extracted_topics_and_scope.title: The Path to Independence and Partition
